Two worlds, one instrument

Shape sounds here, or connect your FM-1 and edit it live. BROWSER

The browser and FM-1 keep separate User Banks. Connect with USB to use the hardware banks.

Hardware editing needs the matching Mutable Dreams 1.3 firmware and Web MIDI with SysEx (Chrome or Edge). Audio comes from the FM-1 while connected; the small display is a live parameter view. Export / Import below transfers one complete live Biome as a file. SAVE keeps it on the selected instrument. Full .mddb backups contain the saved project, preferences and all User Banks; unsaved live edits, granular audio and calibration are excluded. A full restore requires STOP, internal clock, and physical SEL confirmation. Save changes before backing up, or export the live patch separately.

The living background responds to the selected page: sparse settings leave more space, larger grains draw longer forms, and increased modulation brings more movement. It is a guide to settings, not an audio waveform. Hold a function button to see its controls explained on the display. Tap to use it. EDIT: Sound → Filter → Envelope → Mix → Mixer. SEQ: Rhythm → Groove → Bass → Phrase → Sequence → Expression → Flow. FX: Grain → Tape → Space → Modulation → Tidal Motion A → Tidal Motion B → Air. GLO: Harmony → Journey → System → Look → MIDI → Banks. HOME + PRESET: Biome. EDIT + PRESET: sound preset. Every track can use every engine.

Begin with Blank or any factory Biome. Shape your synth voices, kit and phrases, then use GLO → User Banks to select one of 16 Biome slots or 64 sound slots. Enter a name, stop playback, choose internal clock and save. In browser mode, an occupied slot requires a second Save within three seconds. The live FM-1 editor instead asks you to confirm replacement. Browser banks stay in this browser; hardware banks stay on the FM-1. Export each finished Biome as a file for safekeeping. Granular audio is not stored.

GROWING THROUGH YOUR FEEDBACK

Thank you for listening.

Your response to Mutable Dreams has shaped this next chapter. Your requests for warmer sounds, personal Biomes and dependable performance are at the heart of this update. Thank you for making music with it, and for telling us what could be better.

Every voice is yours.

Use six freely assignable synth tracks, or switch to a kit with three synth tracks. The three dormant synth settings are kept when you change modes. Choose from 336 sound presets while keeping your notes, rhythm, levels and sends. An empty Biome is a starting point for a world of your own.

Chance, with a memory.

Euclidean patterns, swing, accents and repeats meet eight shared scales. Lock a seed with ARP, make a variation with REC, and undo it with ENV. Freeze, reverse or transpose the granular cloud as your rhythm keeps moving.

Room to be clear.

Full-rate granular recording, gently overlapping grains and a cleaner signal path bring more detail. Open the filter for clarity or close it for warmth. Gentle resonance and fundamental-led presets keep softer sounds within easy reach. FULL and ECO offer different processing budgets. Automatic admission limits remain in place. The release qualification is documented separately. Dense combinations may require ECO.

VERSION 1.3 / DUST, WARMTH AND MOTION

Give each world its own movement.

01 / NEW TEXTURES

Five original Lo-Fi kits

Forty drum and texture one-shots, forty-eight additional tones and sixteen new Biomes. Play one kit with three synth tracks, or six freely assigned synth tracks.

02 / FOLLOW A NEW PATH

Melodic Flow

Five directions, pattern offset and gentle velocity feel. Eight scale-aware generators and eight chord journeys, with up to sixteen bars per chord and nearby root moves.

03 / TWO TIDES

Two LFOs per synth

Independent targets, curves, depth and cycles. Move colour, panorama, sends or soft swells.

Larger type, calmer dark backgrounds, translucent controls, small living forms and organic envelope curves make room for the music. An accidental Biome change asks before replacing your unsaved edits. Hold a function key for help. On GLO → LOOK / STARTUP, K4 gives the physical button LEDs Off, Dim or Soft backlight.

Browser 1.3 saves are separate from 1.2. Export older browser patches from the retained 1.2 page and import them here. Keep a device bank backup and a separate live-patch export before installing. New 1.3 Biomes require 1.3; older Biomes migrate with neutral new motion settings.

VERSION 1.3 / INSTALL WITH CARE

Keep your worlds. Explore new ones.

Save your Biome, back up all saved User Banks as .mddb, and export unsaved live edits as a separate JSON file. Disconnect the live editor before updating. Connect only the FM-1 you intend to update and keep power and USB attached until the identity is verified.

Install or return to Stock V15 ↗ · Download firmware ↓ · GitHub release ↗

Read the update and recovery guide · Offline installer kit. Stock V15 and V16 were each verified as starting points for this firmware using the exact-device USB update protocol. The official M-UPGRADE application successfully installed Stock V16 from V15, but rejected this custom 1.3 package with “File format error”; use the included browser or Python installer for Mutable Dreams. No direct path from every other custom firmware is claimed.

Returning to Stock V15 erases saved User Banks and preferences. Reinstall Mutable Dreams, restore the .mddb backup with physical SEL on the device, then import a separately exported live patch. Browser storage remains separate from the hardware. USB MIDI was tested; physical TRS-MIDI remains unverified.

WITH GRATITUDE / OUR ROOTS

From a generous idea,
new worlds can grow.

Mutable Dreams owes its foundations to Émilie Gillet and Mutable Instruments. Their instruments and openly shared code made this exploration possible. Selected original algorithms from Plaits, Rings and the new Elements Strike subset form part of our sound engine, with their original credits and MIT notices preserved.

Our contribution is a six-voice instrument for the FM-1: editable Biomes, generative rhythms, a custom granular bus, and an interface that invites discovery. We want to carry that spirit of curiosity into something approachable, expressive, and unmistakably its own.

Explore the original source ↗Discover Plaits ↗Discover Rings ↗

An independent community project, unaffiliated with and not endorsed by Mutable Instruments. These are selected algorithms, not complete module ports. Our granular bus and Round Bass are our own designs. Marbles-inspired remembered variation, Tides-inspired cyclic modulation and Warps-inspired ring blending are original implementations, not complete ports of those modules.

Mutable Dreams · Independent firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1. Selected DSP: Émilie Gillet / Mutable Instruments, MIT. Device platform and simulator: fm1-base / felucca-bsp, MPL-2.0. This browser runs the firmware sound engine; FM-1 performance is measured separately. Browser saves stay on this computer. 16 named User Biomes and 64 user sound slots; factory Biomes remain available. Export your finished Biomes as files for safekeeping. Granular memory: 2.97 seconds, mono PCM16 at 44.1 kHz, with stereo grains. ECO uses half-rate FM / VA / Harmonic voices. Read the measurements and limitations ↗
